en: Black‑and‑white image showing a large alpine-style villa or spa hotel set among tall conifer trees in a forested mountain valley. A narrow river or stream with stone‑lined banks runs in the foreground, crossed by a small wooden footbridge on the left. The multi‑storey building has balconies, wooden verandas, and a small central tower or belfry rising above the roof. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the image side.
